lines.explanation: The card's referent set for the thumbsup obligation is four lunch-question messages (1699572000.000789, 1706052027.000000, 1706052160.000000, 1706052665.000000), explicitly excluding the pizza-combo message (1706051755.000000) per the stated exception. The agent only reacted with :thumbsup: to two of the four required messages (1699572000.000789 and 1706052665.000000), never touching 1706052027.000000 (Lukas's '3 larges?' pizza-quantity question) or 1706052160.000000 (Mateo's garlic-knots question). It additionally applied :thumbsup: to the excluded pizza-combo message (1706051755.000000), directly violating the documented exception. The final response's summary intro (paragraph 1) and thumbsup list (paragraph 2) report only three thumbsup targets, one of which is the excluded pizza-combo message misidentified as a lunch question, and paragraph 4 explicitly (and incorrectly) rationalizes giving the excluded message both reactions as 'overlap,' contrary to the card's exception framing.
